criteria.meaning: Dated, attributable source records are present in the public dossier (not a check of source truth).
Stage/source/assumption links pass mechanical temporal-integrity checks (not historical verification).
Independent evidence establishes which sources/analyses were used for each inference, not merely cited after the fact.
Qualified independent source reviewer inspected primary methods/results and checked claim-to-evidence applicability.
A defensible paired comparison holds the relevant final observation/evidence presentation fixed while independently substantiating the distinct histories.
At least two independent adjudicators have provided sealed determinate or uncertainty ratings without seeing tool outputs.
A fixed generic full-history comparator was run with equivalent permitted evidence and a recorded model/prompt/budget.

cases.scope_note: The 2010, 2013 critique and authors' reply are different data/analysis states; this is not a held-fixed terminal evidence pair. Original spreadsheets were not independently rerun.
Multi-frequency foreground data changed the evidential state; observing the same polarization power is not equivalent to having an unchanged complete evidential summary.

Instrument correction and independent remeasurement changed calibration and observations; treating the final 'compatible with light-speed' wording as an identical terminal evidence state would be unjustified.
